description: Search the web, news, images, scholarly papers and YouTube videos in one call. Also takes maxAge, country, lang, safe, timeout, ignoreInvalidURLs. Free without a key, within limits; with a key, $0.001 per 10 results from each source; pages it reads cost as in stophy_scrape.

highlights.description: true makes description the passages that match the query, where we can.

location.description: Where to search from, such as Germany.

query.description: What to search for. Operators such as site:, -word and quotes work.

scrapeLimit.description: Read only the top this many results.

scrapeOptions.description: stophy_scrape options for each page, such as formats. With formats, each result's page is read.

anyOf.description: Objects with a type: web (tbs, location, country, lang).

tbs.description: Time filter: qdr:d, qdr:w, qdr:m or qdr:y. sbd:1 sorts newest first.

name: stophy_search
title: Search
